clue.text: Cowes has accomodation for the cabinet

indicators.note: accommodation in the sense of adjustment or rearrangement tells us to reorder the letters of the two words before it

parts.note: anagram fodder, taken as written

explanation.surface: The Isle of Wight sailing town of Cowes has rooms ready for the government ministers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accomodation' (misspelt as printed) signals rearranging COWES HAS. Cowes is a yachting town on the Isle of Wight, and 'cabinet' tempts toward government, but it is a glass display case.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass-fronted cupboard for displaying objects is a display case of this kind.

clue.text: Moved forward to encircle the Commanding Officer when beaten

indicators.note: to encircle is to surround, so the advancing word goes round the officer

parts.note: surged means moved forward in a rush
CO is the abbreviation for Commanding Officer

explanation.surface: Troops advanced to surround their commander after defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaten' looks like defeat but means whipped; 'when' is a linking word.
explanation.definitionFit: To whip or flog someone is to beat them as a punishment.

clue.text: Management blunder

definitions.meaning: a mistake through failing to notice

explanation.definitionFit: Supervision is watchful charge, while an omission through not noticing is a slip: the same word covers both.

clue.text: Net is not obstructing the view

definitions.meaning: net profit is what remains after deductions

explanation.definitionFit: Net earnings are those after deductions, and a transparent window or an unblocked view is unobstructed.

clue.text: A resort area that sets the South-east apart

parts.note: SE is the abbreviation for South-east
aside means apart, to one side

explanation.surface: A holiday town that makes the South-east of England special.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that sets' is linking: SE is followed by ASIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Coastal towns where holidaymakers go are beach resorts.

clue.text: Share out the lot

definitions.meaning: to divide up and distribute in portions
an auction lot is a package or bundle of goods

explanation.definitionFit: To divide into portions is to apportion, and at auction a lot is a bundle offered as one item.

clue.text: Some people tucked 'in at home

indicators.note: tucked in means placed inside, so the pieces go within the little word at

parts.note: part means some
men means people

explanation.surface: Some folk staying snugly in at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked 'in' places PART and MEN inside AT.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat or set of rooms is a dwelling place.

clue.text: A hill-top pile-up

parts.note: not a traffic crash, but stones piled up as a marker on a summit

explanation.definitionFit: A mound of stones heaped on a summit marks the top of a hill.

clue.text: A person making advances to show interest

definitions.text: A person making advances to show interest

parts.words: A person making advances to show interest
parts.note: not a suitor showing romantic interest, but someone advancing money to earn interest

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who advances money expects interest on the loan.

clue.text: "But ______ were made for tankards" (Masefield)

parts.note: a gap-fill from a line by the poet John Masefield, naming what tankards are lifted to

explanation.definitionFit: Tankards are drinking mugs, lifted to the openings in faces used for drinking.

clue.text: Over-large order given by heartless woman

parts.note: the OBE, Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the woman's name drops out

parts.note: Sue is a woman's name

explanation.surface: An instruction issued by a cold-hearted woman to someone too big.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a command but is the British honour OBE; 'heartless' takes the middle U out of SUE to leave SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Grossly overweight people are described as fat beyond what is healthy.

clue.text: If a fellow admits a relationship it must be love

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so the relationship word goes inside

parts.note: a don is a college fellow at Oxford or Cambridge
a ratio is a numerical relationship between two quantities

explanation.surface: If a man owns up to an affair, it must surely be love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admits' puts RATIO inside A DON; 'If' and 'it must be' are linking words.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep devotion or worship is the strongest form of affection.

clue.text: Exercise during leisure to develop self-control

indicators.note: one thing happening during another sits within it, so the exercise word goes inside the leisure word

parts.note: rest is leisure or relaxation
to train is to exercise

explanation.surface: Working out in your spare time to build up discipline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'during' places TRAIN inside REST; 'to develop' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding oneself back from excess is the restraint of strong discipline.

clue.text: Drawn in the past possibly.

definitions.meaning: drawn as in strained and taut, as a drawn face
the past is one example of a grammatical time form of a verb

explanation.definitionFit: A drawn face looks taut and strained, and the past is one grammatical time form a verb takes.

clue.text: To eat too much might well make one go green!

indicators.note: the letters might well make a new word when rearranged, so they are to be reshuffled

parts.note: anagram fodder, taken as written

explanation.surface: Overeating could easily turn one queasy and green in the face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might well make' asks for GO GREEN to be rearranged; 'one' is a linking word.
explanation.definitionFit: To gorge or cram oneself with food is to eat to excess.

clue.text: Complete letters for the queen in sound translation

indicators.note: in places the complete and queen pieces inside the sound word

parts.note: to ring is to sound, as a bell
to end is to complete
ER, Elizabeth Regina, are the initials used for the Queen

explanation.surface: Finishing a royal correspondence in a good audio rendition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like a description of the translation but is RING; 'letters' are initials, not post.
explanation.definitionFit: A version of a text in another language is a rendering of it.

clue.text: The carriage of some sadly misled gentlefolk

indicators.note: some of the following words means a run of letters is taken from inside them

explanation.surface: A carriage belonging to unfortunate, deceived gentry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' points to the letters running through misLED GEntlefolk; 'sadly' is surface colour. 'carriage' suggests a coach, but a sledge carries people over snow.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle on runners for travelling over snow is a kind of carriage.

clue.text: One with no experience of environment-friendly. natural growth

parts.note: green means environmentally friendly
a horn grows naturally from an animal's head

explanation.surface: A novice in ecological organic farming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a linking word.
explanation.definitionFit: A raw beginner is an inexperienced novice.

clue.text: They feel a girl will turn in neat results

indicators.note: in puts the turned girl inside the rearranged letters
results here means the outcome of reworking the letters of neat

parts.note: anagram fodder, taken as written

indicators.note: turning round means the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Some feelers claim a young woman will hand in tidy outcomes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'results' rearranges NEAT to ANTE; 'will turn' reverses ANNE to ENNA, which goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's feelers are the organs it uses to sense by touch.

clue.text: Checks tricky manoeuvres

definitions.meaning: to check growth is to stunt it
daring feats, as performed by film doubles

explanation.definitionFit: To halt growth is to stunt it, and daring feats performed for show are stunts.

clue.text: Gloomy houses before being extended

indicators.note: houses means holds within, so the gloomy word goes round the word for before

parts.note: sad means gloomy
pre is a prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: A gloomy mood holds sway before it grows wider.
explanation.walkthrough: 'houses' looks like a noun but is a verb: SAD holds PRE; 'being' is a linking word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stretched out or opened wide has been spread out.

clue.text: A model talk must come to the point

indicators.note: the talk word comes to, reaching, the point that follows it

parts.note: patter is glib talk, as of a salesman
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A fashion model's chatter has to get to the point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the point' is a compass point, N, not the purpose of the talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A design or template to be copied serves as a model.

clue.text: Getting cash back on a horse

parts.note: P, penny or pence, stands for a small sum of cash
astern means at the back, to the rear of a ship

explanation.surface: Collecting the money returned after a bet on a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' is not a reversal; it is ASTERN. 'Getting' links. A horse's pastern is the part of the leg between fetlock and hoof.
explanation.definitionFit: The part of a horse's foot between fetlock and hoof is found on its leg.

clue.text: Supported the plot to hold transport up

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so the plot word goes round the transport

parts.note: a bed is a garden plot

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word reads backwards

parts.note: a car is a form of transport

explanation.surface: Reinforced the scheme to delay the vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns CAR into RAC; 'plot' looks like a scheme but is a flower BED.
explanation.definitionFit: Propped up with a brace or strut is supported.

clue.text: General carrying the sovereign's weapon

indicators.note: carrying means holding something inside, so the sovereign goes within the general word

parts.note: rife means general or widespread
a sovereign is a pound coin, and L is the abbreviation for pound

explanation.surface: An army general bearing the monarch's gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'General' looks like an officer but is the adjective RIFE, widespread; 'sovereign' is the British gold pound coin, L.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-barrelled gun fired from the shoulder is a firearm.

clue.text: Use foil to enclose

definitions.meaning: a foil is a light sword used in the sport of swordplay

explanation.definitionFit: Wielding a foil is swordplay, and surrounding land with railings or palings shuts it in.

clue.text: Sort of vibration damage seen on car

indicators.note: damage wrecks the order of the letters of the words that follow

parts.note: anagram fodder, taken as written

explanation.surface: A rattling noise caused by the dents seen on the vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damage' rearranges SEEN ON CAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Sympathetic vibration at a natural frequency, prolonging sound, is a kind of oscillation.

clue.text: Dark grotesque thing

indicators.note: grotesque means distorted, so the letters of thing are bent out of shape

parts.note: anagram fodder, taken as written

explanation.surface: A dark, monstrous creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grotesque' rearranges THING. 'Dark' as a noun is the time after sunset.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark is the period after sunset when it is unlit.

clue.text: Frank scoffed, though he wanted the job

parts.note: frank means candid, open
to scoff is to eat greedily, so scoffed gives ate

explanation.surface: Frank laughed at it, even though he had wanted that post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a name and 'scoffed' like mockery; they are CANDID and ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An applicant seeking a post is someone hoping to be chosen for it.

clue.text: Enlarged, the dress is about right

indicators.note: being about means surrounding, so the dress word goes round the letter for right

parts.note: a gown is a dress

explanation.surface: The dress has been let out to fit properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has increased in size has become bigger.

clue.text: Scrape the bottom

parts.note: not scraping a barrel, but scooping mud and silt from the bed of a river or harbour

explanation.definitionFit: Clearing silt from a riverbed with a scoop or net is scraping the bottom.

clue.text: An illustration demonstrating the current attitude

parts.note: in means fashionable, current
a stance is an attitude or position

explanation.surface: A picture showing what is now the fashionable outlook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' suggests electricity, but here it means fashionable, IN; 'demonstrating' is a linking word.
explanation.definitionFit: An example cited to make a point is an illustration of it.
